<div class="alignfull wp-block-acf-heading">
<div class="header-section style-light alignfull">
    <div class="heading-block-acf__innerblocks">

<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Your partner through it all.</h2>



<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">We’re an independent community bank located in southeastern Massachusetts and are proud to back the communities we call home. We have helped our local area flourish since 1872 and are dedicated to providing caring service and financial insight to families and businesses in Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and New Hampshire—come bank with us!</p>

</div>

        <div class="featured-block-acf__innerblocks">

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Bluestone can help <br>make it happen.</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">With over 150 years of combined experience, Bluestone can guide you through every stage of your financial journey. We can help plan your investment strategy,* whether you’re simply managing your money or looking to buy a home or starting a business. Public entities trust Bluestone for everything from cash management to deposit protection. We think you should too.</p>

<div class="alignfull wp-block-acf-heading">
<div class="header-section style-dark alignfull">
    <div class="heading-block-acf__innerblocks">

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Rest Assured,<br><em>Your Deposits Are Safe!</em></h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">When it comes to your hard-earned money, you deserve a bank that will guarantee its safety.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>All deposits at Bluestone Bank are 100% insured.</strong> This is made possible through the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), which insures up to $250,000.00 per depositor with the excess over $250,000.00 insured by the <a href="https://difxs.com/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Depositors Insurance Fund<span class="visually-hidden"> (opens in a new tab)</span></a> (DIF). No depositor has ever lost money in a bank insured by both the FDIC and DIF.</p>

</div>
</div>
</div>
